subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
stimulus: Shakib-Al-Hasan, born 24, March 1987 is a Bangladeshi international cricketer. He is an allrounder, batting left handed in the middle order and bowling slow left arm orthodox. He represented Bangladesh at under 19 level youth One Day Internationals between 2005 and 2006. Shakib made his One Day International (ODI) debut against Zimbabwe in August 2006 and his Test debut the following May against India. During a match against New Zealand in 2008, Shakib took the best bowling figures by a Bangladeshi player in Tests 7 wickets for 36 runs, from January 2009 to April 2011 and again from the worlds top ranked test allrounder. The Bangladesh Cricket Board founded the six team Bangladesh Premier League in 2012, a twenty 20 tournament to be held in February that year. The BCB made Sakib the "icon player" for Khulna Royal Bengals. Under his captaincy, Shakib's team progressed to the semifinals of the competition where they were beaten by Dhaka Gladiators. In the matches he scored 286 runs and took 15 wickets, which made him KRBS leading wicket taker and was awarded Man of the Tournament. The Indian Premier League was held in April and May and Shakib played in eight of KKRS 18 Matches and won two man of the match awards. ক্যাপটেন SSC English Test Papers | 40  in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences.
